const FRESH_WORLD_V16_LAYOUT := "res://build/world_coast_20261031h_system01/world_v16_layout02.tres"

static func _world_v16_source_paths() -> Dictionary:
	var out: Dictionary={}
	if FRESH_WORLD_V16_PINS.size()!=7:return out
	for path: String in FRESH_WORLD_V16_PINS:
		if not _hash(FRESH_WORLD_V16_PINS[path]) or FileAccess.get_sha256(path)!=FRESH_WORLD_V16_PINS[path]:return {}
		out[path]=true
	return out

static func _fresh_world_v16_portal_matches(source: StringName,target: StringName,normalized: Vector2,route: Dictionary) -> bool:
	if source not in [&"world_map_jianghu",&"world_map_jianghu_v16"] or target!=&"ch4_s0_luoyang_gate" or normalized!=Vector2(.5,.9):return false
	if route.get("portal")!="luoyang" or route.get("slot")!="return_world" or route.get("foot")!=Vector2(1536,1860) or route.get("reverse")!=false:return false
	if _world_v16_source_paths().is_empty():return false
	var manifest: Variant=JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(FRESH_WORLD_V16_MANIFEST))
	if not manifest is Dictionary or manifest.get("coordinate_version")!=16 or manifest.get("scene_id")!="world_map_jianghu_v16" or manifest.get("scene_path")!=FRESH_WORLD_V16_SCENE or manifest.get("layout_path")!=FRESH_WORLD_V16_LAYOUT or manifest.get("stream_path")!=FRESH_WORLD_V16_STREAM:return false
	if manifest.get("scene_sha256")!=FRESH_WORLD_V16_PINS[FRESH_WORLD_V16_SCENE] or manifest.get("layout_sha256")!=FRESH_WORLD_V16_PINS[FRESH_WORLD_V16_LAYOUT] or manifest.get("stream_sha256")!=FRESH_WORLD_V16_PINS[FRESH_WORLD_V16_STREAM]:return false
	var path: String=FRESH_WORLD_V16_CANONICAL if source==&"world_map_jianghu" else FRESH_WORLD_V16_SCENE
	var original:=ResourceLoader.load(path,"",ResourceLoader.CACHE_MODE_IGNORE) as SceneScript
	var layout:=ResourceLoader.load(FRESH_WORLD_V16_LAYOUT,"",ResourceLoader.CACHE_MODE_IGNORE) as WalkableMapLayout
	if FileAccess.get_sha256(FRESH_WORLD_V15_SOURCE.layout)!=FRESH_WORLD_V15_SOURCE.layout_sha:return false
	var old_layout:=ResourceLoader.load("res://data/maps/world_map_jianghu_layout_v15.tres","",ResourceLoader.CACHE_MODE_IGNORE) as WalkableMapLayout
	if original==null or original.scene_id!=source or original.map_layout==null or original.map_layout.resource_path!=FRESH_WORLD_V16_LAYOUT or layout==null or old_layout==null:return false
	if layout.schema_version!=15 or layout.design_size!=Vector2i(12288,8192) or typeof(layout.get_meta("coordinate_space_version",null))!=TYPE_INT or layout.get_meta("coordinate_space_version")!=16 or layout.get_meta("geography_revision","")!="world_coast_20261031h":return false
	if original.streamed_background==null or original.streamed_background.resource_path!=FRESH_WORLD_V16_STREAM or original.background_path!="res://art/maps/world_coast_20261031h/candidate02/overview.png":return false
	var old_rows: Array[Dictionary]=[]
	var new_rows: Array[Dictionary]=[]
	for portal: Dictionary in old_layout.portals:
		if String(portal.get("id",""))=="luoyang":old_rows.append(portal)
	for portal: Dictionary in layout.portals:
		if String(portal.get("id",""))=="luoyang":new_rows.append(portal)
	if old_rows.size()!=1 or new_rows.size()!=1 or var_to_bytes(old_rows[0])!=var_to_bytes(new_rows[0]):return false
	return String(new_rows[0].get("target_scene",""))==String(target) and new_rows[0].get("target_pos") is Vector2 and new_rows[0].target_pos==normalized
